remarks: Welcome to 3 Caryns Way A, a beautifully maintained and like-new 3-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom townhome located on a peaceful cul-de-sac in the heart of Norwalk. Offering three spacious levels of modern living, this home delivers both style and functionality in a prime Fairfield County location. The main floor features a bright, open-concept layout with hardwood flooring throughout, perfect for entertaining or everyday living. The chef's kitchen boasts sleek quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, ample cabinetry, and a breakfast bar that flows seamlessly into the living and dining areas. The primary suite offers a walk-in closet and a spa-like bath with vaulted ceilings and a walk in shower. Two additional bedroom share a bath with ample closet space. The is a full sized side by side laundry on the upper level behind stylish barn doors. The finished lower level includes a full bath and provides the perfect space for a media room, home gym, or in-law/guest suite. Additional highlights include a one-car attached garage, central air conditioning, energy-efficient systems, and a private outdoor patio. Located just minutes from I-95, the Merritt Parkway, South Norwalk (SONO), Metro-North, shopping, dining, and beaches, this home offers low-maintenance luxury in a highly convenient setting.
